prompt: A declared test script of node --test '--test-isolation=none' must not be vouched. The recognizer treats the quoted flag as a file pattern, confirmation skips it, the shell unquotes it, and node takes last-wins isolation=none so the test authors the lcov.

A declared test script of node --test '--require=./hook.cjs' must not be vouched. The quoted hook is classified as a file pattern, survives confirmation, and loads in the process that writes the coverage artifact.
A declared test script of node --test '--env-file=.env' must not be vouched. The env file is workspace-controlled and can set NODE_OPTIONS=--require=./hook.cjs, which the token scan never sees.
A vouched node --test must not measure while NODE_OPTIONS=--require=./hook.cjs is inherited by the gate runner. The confirmation reads the command string, not the environment.

Two complete lcov sections for clamp.mjs that together name every changed line must not measure as 9/9 when the first section only measured line 1. Union of DA keys across sections is not a measurement of those lines.
A NODE_OPTIONS --require hook must not author the TAP artifact the base-control run attributes from. A passing sibling named as not-ok in that file is not a new specification.
A failing subtest that reuses a skipped top-level test's name is not a base-source failure of that top-level test. Node emitting not ok - innocentNew for the subtest must not clear a deletion.
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'mul') on the base source is the missing export, not a new specification. Same for Cannot destructure property. Do not grant the escape hatch.
A TODO spelled in mathematical bold capitals (U+1D400) still reads as TODO to a person. The placeholder gate must block it, or section 7.1 must keep naming the unlisted-script boundary.
